senses.zh_definition: （印尼语词典所收巽他语词，历史称谓）旧时对县长子女使用的称号。
senses.en_definition: A historical Sundanese title for a regent’s child, recorded in Indonesian lexicography.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks sejarah masyarakat Sunda, gelaran bagi anak bupati pada zaman dahulu.
senses.nuances: 此义有印尼官方语言资料支持，但本次未能核实其作为马来西亚标准马来语词条的身份。马来语释义为编写的解释，并非 DBP 官方释文。下列搭配为解释性短语，不代表已验证的高频搭配。[印尼教育部《Jendela》所列词义](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/31358/1/JENDELA_EDISI_62.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: （印尼语词典所收巽他语词）幼蜘蛛。
senses.en_definition: A young spider; a Sundanese word recorded in Indonesian lexicography.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan bahasa Sunda yang direkodkan dalam perkamusan Indonesia, anak labah-labah.
senses.nuances: 这是另一个有记录的同形词义，不应从历史称号义推导而来，也不应直接当作马来西亚日常用词教授。下列短语仅用于讨论词义。[Umi Kulsum 关于 KBBI 中巽他语词汇的研究](https://download.garuda.kemdikbud.go.id/article.php?article=953249&title=MENYELISIK+KOSAKATA+BAHASA+SUNDA+DALAM+KAMUS+BESAR+BAHASA+INDONESIA+PUSAT+BAHASA+EDISI+IV&val=14688)

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian language authorities identify aom as a Sundanese contribution to Indonesian vocabulary, specifically a historical title for a regent’s child. This illustrates how dictionaries preserve regional social institutions alongside everyday vocabulary. Another recorded Sundanese homograph means a young spider. These records establish regional meanings; they do not establish a shared origin or official Malaysian Malay status. [Badan Bahasa](https://badanbahasa.kemendikdasmen.go.id/artikel-detail/792/kontribusi-kosakata-bahasa-daerah-dalam-bahasa-indonesia)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aom 放进两张图：旧时县长家的孩子、刚孵化的小蜘蛛。按语境分别记忆；读音未核实，不编造谐音。
